items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: I have two sisters, Sister Mary and Sister Mary.

ctx.x: And they had moved over there, I guess?

Yeah, my father was with the Tex-Pacific Railroad, and he had gone over there, and they had been living in Marshall for several years. I have two sisters, Sister Mary and Sister Mary. They were both older than I. And so, I often say I was made in Texas and born in Mississippi.
And were they musicals at Browning?
